findings.summary: No declaration states (7.42) as three separate memberships, or the per-term divergence loss. Lean bounds only the sum B(E,LΣ)+B(U,R)+C(V) in M_γ, γ ≤ min(ρ+α−1/2, α+1/2−κ_s, 2α−1). Each separate bound is an instance of harmonic_covariance_sum_mem.

The field-level split leaves B(W0^as, L^asΣ) in place of Σ. The identification with Σ is stated for every σ only at the native-assembly level. At the field level it is stated only for the requested stress (requested_cross, native_family_cross).
SignedFamily takes the classes of U, E, the tangent increment and R as abstract inputs. It does not require U or V to be divergence-free, the tangent to equal L^asΣ, or R to come from Lemma 7.7.

The conclusion class M_γ is MemClass: smoothness on s.domain plus ζ-weighted all-order bounds. It omits Definition 6.4's descent to each common torus and its explicit smooth zero extension outside the shell. This is cross-cutting with Def 6.4.
